headline: Margins widen and profit grows, but debt keeps climbing
summary_short: PG&E reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $5,902M, essentially flat y/y (+0.1%) but down 14.2% q/q; net income rose 38.6% y/y to $761M and diluted EPS climbed to $0.33 from $0.24 a year ago, though both eased back from a stronger first quarter.
summary_long: Revenue of $5,902M was roughly flat y/y (+0.1%) but fell 14.2% q/q from a stronger first quarter. Operating income rose 15.2% y/y to $1,263M and EBITDA gained 4.0% y/y to $2,532M, pointing to margin expansion on flat revenue, though both slipped versus the prior quarter. Net income climbed 38.6% y/y to $761M; diluted EPS rose to $0.33 from $0.24. Cash of $972M nearly doubled y/y (+96.8%) but declined 14.1% q/q. Long-term debt rose to $61,768M, up 14.4% y/y and 2.7% q/q.
